test_suite_metadata.title: Resume PII Redaction Test Suite - Indian & International Candidates
test_suite_metadata.description: 10 synthetic resume samples covering Indian and international candidate PII (Aadhaar, PAN, Passport, SSN, SIN, NI, TFN, NRIC, Steuer-ID, driving licence, addresses, DOB, phones, emails) plus false-positive traps (profile URLs, CGPA, currency, credential IDs, employment/education date ranges).
test_suite_metadata.target_audience: HR / recruiting pipelines ingesting resumes (ATS, screening agents)
